# Kenrax Industries - Industrial Air Compressor Filters & Spares

> Kenrax is a trusted Indian manufacturer and supplier of OEM replacement air filters, oil filters, air-oil separators, and hydraulic filters for rotary screw air compressors. Based in New Delhi, India.

## Products

- **Air Filters** - Removes airborne contaminants from intake air. Compatible with Atlas Copco, Ingersoll Rand, Elgi, Kaeser, CP, Kirloskar, Gardner Denver, and more.
- **Oil Filters** - Filters contaminants from compressor lubricating oil. Direct drop-in replacements for all major OEMs.
- **Air-Oil Separators** - Separates oil from compressed air using advanced coalescing media. Low oil-carryover designs.
- **Hydraulic Filters** - Removes contaminants from hydraulic fluid. For industrial equipment protection.

## Key Features

- OEM-compatible aftermarket parts
- High-grade materials for durability
- Direct drop-in fit - no modifications needed
- Competitive pricing with bulk discounts
- Fast shipping across India
- Private labeling and white-label manufacturing available
